newsitem.title: UK: BBA says sells P.C. Cox for 20 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: BBA says sells P.C. Cox for 20 mln stg.

text.p: British engineering and materials firm BBA Group Plc announced on Monday the sale of the business and assets of P.C. Cox (Newbury) Ltd to a new group formed by CVC Capital Partners Ltd for 20 million stg.
BBA said the deal comprises 18 million stg in cash on completion and the balance in loan notes.
"This sale follows BBA's strategy of disposing of non-core businesses," the company said. P.C. Cox manufactures sealant applicators.
The proceeds will be used to reduce its net borrowings, it said.
